title: Delivery & Pickup Appointments Scheduling Calendar by Fulfillment Method
content:
Each fulfillment method of Delivery & Pickup Appointments offers appointments on its own calendar. The calendar sets how soon after signing an appointment can be held, how far ahead it can be booked, which days and windows are open, and how many appointments one customer may hold in a single window.

## Calendar figures

| Fulfillment method | Minimum lead after the purchase agreement signing date | Maximum horizon after the booking date | Windows offered | Appointment days | Most appointments one customer may hold on the same date and window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | 1 calendar day | 14 calendar days | 08:00-12:00, 12:00-16:00, 16:00-20:00 | Mon to Sat | 2 |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | 2 calendar days | 14 calendar days | 08:00-12:00, 12:00-16:00, 16:00-20:00 | Mon to Sun (every day) | 1 |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | 3 calendar days | 21 calendar days | 08:00-12:00, 12:00-16:00 | Mon to Sat | 1 |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | 2 calendar days | 14 calendar days | 08:00-12:00, 12:00-16:00, 16:00-20:00 | Mon to Sat | 2 |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | 4 calendar days | 21 calendar days | 08:00-12:00, 12:00-16:00 | Mon to Fri | 1 |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | 5 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 08:00-12:00 | Mon to Fri | 1 |

## Holiday closures

All six methods are closed on the same six US holidays. No appointments are offered on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day or Christmas Day, even when the holiday falls on one of the method's appointment days.

## Definitions

- **Minimum lead**: the least number of calendar days that must separate the purchase agreement signing date from the appointment date.
- **Maximum horizon**: the greatest number of calendar days that may separate the booking date from the appointment date.
- **Windows offered**: the appointment windows the method offers.
- **Appointment days**: the days of the week on which the method offers appointments.
- **Most appointments per window**: the greatest number of appointments one customer may hold on the same date and window, across all of that customer's orders.

## Calendar notes

- Sunday appointments are offered only by Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup. Saturday appointments are offered by every method except Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery and Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery.
- The evening window, 16:00-20:00, is offered by Hub Pickup, Vending Tower Pickup and Local Home Delivery. Enclosed White-Glove Delivery offers only the morning window, 08:00-12:00.
- Only Hub Pickup and Local Home Delivery let one customer hold two appointments in the same date and window. Every other method allows one.
